original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国纪念《德班宣言》25周年，古特雷斯呼吁加强全球行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国大会于9月28日在纽约举行高级别会议，纪念2001年在南非德班通过的反对种族主义《德班宣言和行动纲领》25周年。联合国秘书长古特雷斯在会上表示，种族主义仍在毒害社会、加深不平等，并呼吁各国政府加强并有效执行反歧视与平等法律。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 联合国大会举行高级别会议纪念《德班宣言》25周年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The General Assembly held today (28 Sep) a one-day high-level meeting to mark the twenty-fifth anniversary of the anti-racism Durban Declaration and Programme of Action, adopted in Durban, South Africa, in 2001.

key_facts.fact: 古特雷斯称种族主义仍在毒害社会、加深不平等
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: racism continues to poison societies, deepen inequalities, and deny people their fundamental rights and freedoms.

key_facts.fact: 古特雷斯呼吁各国政府加强并有效执行反歧视与平等法律
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Governments must strengthen and effectively implement anti-discrimination and equality laws, and the institutions that enforce them.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
